events.text: Area included into Archangelgorod Governorate under Peter the Great's reform.

evidence.quote: In the course of the administrative reform carried out in 1708 by Peter the Great , the area was included into Archangelgorod Governorate

events.text: Area became part of Vologda Governorate, Velikoustyugsky Uyezd.

evidence.quote: The latter was abolished in 1796 , and the part of it which included Nyuksenitsa became Vologda Governorate

events.text: Area transferred to the newly established Northern Dvina Governorate.

evidence.quote: In 1918 , the area was transferred to the newly established Northern Dvina Governorate

events.label: founding
events.text: Nyuksensky District established, incorporating areas of former uyezds.

evidence.quote: Nyuksensky District was established on June 10 , 1924
On February 27 , 1928 , it was renamed Sukhonsky District

events.label: founding
events.text: Nyuksensky District re-established by merging Sukhonsky and Kokshengsky Districts.

evidence.quote: On July 30 , 1931 , Sukhonsky and Kokshengsky Districts were merged , and Nyuksensky District was re-established

events.text: Tarnogsky District split off from Nyuksensky District.

evidence.quote: In 1935 , Tarnogsky District was split off from Nyuksensky District

events.text: Northern Oblast split; district remained in Vologda Oblast.

evidence.quote: in 1937 , Northern Oblast itself was split into Arkhangelsk Oblast and Vologda Oblast

undated_mentions: Area colonized by the Novgorod Republic (Totma) and Vladimir-Suzdal Principality (Veliky Ustyug)
Area became part of the Grand Duchy of Moscow after the fall of Novgorod
Cattle farming in crisis after the fall in the 1990s
